t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Use the multiplier of 1 to determine which gnomes are the higher point earners and choose these as a safe guess for the multiplier of 5.

vb_textbox.text: Personally i found the Green, the brown and the blue were the best options however i followed the previous advice i received to try the different colours on the 1 multiplier to see which had a better score, above 3 tended to be the higher point preferences, this can be used to your advantage on the 5 multipliers. i personally didnt take advantage of the breaks however by the last block of the game i really struggled to concentrate so i would advice taking the breaks when offered.
